item.title: Version 1.5.82
item.description:
✨ v1.5.82 Update

  • Quote Last Match — In a supported editor, put quotation marks around the text from the last match up to the cursor.
  • Move Before Text — In a supported editor, move the cursor to the start of the last match before it. Both actions are available in the Action Library under Productivity.
  • Settings and AI Action Studio now highlight more controls when you hover or press them, including preset rows and Chat History.
